steps.text:
**Commanding officer(s) of HMS Sharpshooter (J 68) who received a Distinguished Service Order (DSO) between the start of World II (1 Sep 1939) and the surrender of Nazi Germany (8 May 1945):**

| Rank & Name | Dates of Command (WW II period) | DSO Award |
|-------------|---------------------------------|-----------|
| Lieutenant‑Commander **Robert Bill, DSO, RN** | 1 June 1945 – 31 July 1945 | Awarded the DSO |

*Robert Bill is the only commanding officer listed for HMS Sharpshooter during the WWII period who was recorded as receiving the Distinguished Service Order.*  

**Sources**

- “HMS Sharpshooter – Crew – Halcyon Class Minesweepers” (http://www.halcyon‑class.co.uk/sharpshooter/sharpshooter_crew.htm) shows the command table and identifies *Lt.Cdr. Robert Bill, DSO, RN* serving from June 1945 to 31 July 1945【commentary:3】.  
- The same table lists other commanders (Jack Peterson, DSC; Andrew Doran; David Lampen; William O'Mara; David Ramsay, DSC; Ernest Croome) without a DSO designation, confirming that no other commanding officer in that period held the award.  

Thus the only HMS Sharpshooter commanding officer awarded the DSO during WWII was Lieutenant‑Commander Robert Bill.
